metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the standard-library iCalendar parser and recurrence expander.

- Entry point: [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py)
- Executable: [output/ical](/workspace/output/ical)
- Supports parse/expand commands, RFC components, RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE, overrides, VTIMEZONE/DST handling, RSCALE examples, warnings, and required JSON schemas.
- Verified with syntax checks and end-to-end parse/expand fixtures.

    def test_yearend_gap_detected_via_neighbor_year_scan(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """Proves detect_tz_anomaly's (y-1, y, y+1) scan, not just year-y.
    
        Fixture: +00:00 → +01:00 spring-forward at local 2025-12-31 23:30.
        The gap runs [2025-12-31 23:30, 2026-01-01 00:30). An event at
        local 2026-01-01 00:15 is INSIDE the gap — but the transition is
        anchored to Dec 31 of the PRIOR year (2025). A detector that
        enumerates only the event's own year (2026) would generate the
        Dec 31 2026 23:30 transition, which is nowhere near the event.
        Catching this event requires scanning year 2025 (i.e. event.year - 1).
    
        If this test fails, the multi-year scan regressed to single-year."""
        body = (
            "UID:e-yearend\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\n"
            # Local 2026-01-01 00:15 lies in the 2025-12-31T23:30 +01:00 gap.
            "DTSTART;TZID=Test/YearEndGap:20260101T001500\n"
        )
        out = run_expand(
            submission_command,
            _wrap_yearend_tz(body),
            "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z",
            tmp_path,
        )

        """Require the public diagnostic while allowing either validation phase.
    
        summary.md §6 applies orphan checks uniformly to events/todos/journals;

editorial.last_message: Reports a standard-library parser/expander with successful syntax and end-to-end smoke checks. Completes voluntarily at456/467; smoke claims are supported, but gap offsets, iTIP rules and orphan warnings remain incomplete and unacknowledged.
editorial.notes: Primary and independent source/spec/transcript review maps11 observations to timezone-gap3, iTIP5 and orphan-warning3 groups. Two explicit gap starts use post-transition instead of RFC-required pre-transition offsets. The year-end case does scan neighboring years, but the same wrong offset shifts the event before the UTC query window; warn=False prefilter then suppresses both event and diagnostic. VEVENT CANCEL lacks STATUS validation, ADD lacks RECURRENCE-ID prohibition, two valid COUNTER cases spuriously require positive SEQUENCE, and DECLINECOUNTER adds invalid positive-SEQUENCE/PARTSTAT requirements. Ordinary no-master VEVENT and VTODO/VJOURNAL overrides omit orphan diagnostics. None involve the known raw-property ambiguity. Gap behavior follows conflicting summary wording, but the supplied RFC has explicit precedence; retain the frozen score and deferred summary clarification. Substantial Python implementation, syntax and final parse/expand fixtures successful; final verification is smoke coverage, not hidden-suite perfection. Recovered diagnostic probes/tool errors did not terminate work. Voluntary completion after74minutes with no quota/auth/network/operator failure, no rerun indicated. Exact310tools recovered only in publication; raw nulls unchanged. Canonical tokens and$1.436561 reconcile. Secondary telemetry includes one compaction request244554input/243456cached/3328output, rate-equivalent$0.00908232, omitted by established canonical accounting and retained as a caveat.
